name: FY2013 PMMR Agency Performance Indicators
description:
This dataset contains performance indicators reported by New York City agencies for fiscal year 2013 as part of the Mayor's Management Report (PMMR). Each row represents a single reported measure for an agency, identified by an indicator ID and name, and often broken out by a sub-indicator. Rows also record the desired direction of improvement, whether the measure is flagged as critical, the geographic scope (such as citywide), the measure type, and the fiscal year, which spans 2010 through 2014 in the sampled data. Reported results appear in several formats: percentages, plain numbers, currency amounts, times, and ratios, with the relevant value stored in the matching value column.

The data can be used to track how city agencies perform on service delivery and accountability measures, compare indicators across agencies, and identify critical or underperforming measures.
